rules: Prefer editing the current Spark when it can satisfy the request.
Never replace a Spark for copy-only, media-only, repeater CRUD, or bounded visual-token changes.
For repeater CRUD, discover the existing collection key and preserve sibling item schema.
Adding an item clones the nearest valid item shape, then applies only requested fields.
Removing an item must target an explicit item index or uniquely matched item label/title.
Element edits apply only to resolved matched paths.
When an active repeater item is supplied, its item index is authoritative and matching must stay inside that item unless the user explicitly says all, every, or each item in that collection.
Slider navigation changes selection only; a normal edit targets the currently active slide and never a hidden sibling slide.
Unknown edit keys are rejected rather than silently inserted.
A structural layout/media capability change may replace the Spark only when the current Spark cannot represent it.
Preserve type, render key, dynamic bindings, and unrelated fields.

response_rules: A success response must describe the target that the server actually verified.
For active-item edits, name the item type and one-based item number in the response.
Never say done, updated, removed, added, or applied when execution verification cannot claim completion.
A partial result must identify that some requested work was not verified.
Manual direct edits cost zero credits and should say so in the Builder response.
